compose_two_gtn_graphs: compose two GTN graphs using gtn.compose to chain transducer automata together
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp scoring
find_viterbi_path: find the best Viterbi path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path
concatenate_gtn_graphs: concatenate multiple GTN graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to build longer automata
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove to simplify the automaton
